from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitReport(BaseModel):
    """Profit data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    profit_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label, e.g. '利润总额'")
    profit_value: float | None = Field(description="The profit amount numeric value")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale, e.g. '元', '百万元', '千万元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the profit figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    profit_reports: list[CompanyProfitReport]
